class.name: CrimsonWeaponAnimationClip
class.brief_description: Detached runtime reader for one weapon animation.
class.description: Reads authored markers, notify events and float curves from a saved clip. Create a snapshot once when selecting an animation. Reading or mutating a returned record does not change the animation or snapshot.

method.name: from_animation
method.description: Read an independent snapshot of the clip. Returns null when the animation or its track metadata is invalid.

method.name: from_player
method.description: Look up the qualified [param key] accepted by [method AnimationPlayer.play]. Returns null when the player or animation is missing or when its data is invalid.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Return the source duration in seconds, or zero for an empty snapshot.

method.name: get_curve_names
method.description: Return curve names in authoring order.

method.name: get_curve_info
method.description: Return a detached curve name, key count, and optional color. An unknown name returns an empty dictionary.

method.name: get_curve_keys
method.description: Return detached key rows including normalized phase, seconds, value, interpolation mode, and tangent attributes. An unknown name returns an empty array.

method.name: sample_curve
method.description: Evaluate a curve at the given clip time in seconds, clamped to the clip range. Returns [param fallback] if the curve or time is unavailable.

method.name: sample_curve_normalized
method.description: Evaluate at [param phase] clamped to the range from zero to one. Supports constant, linear, cubic, and weighted tangent curves. Returns [param fallback] for a missing curve, an empty curve, or a nonfinite phase.

method.name: get_markers
method.description: Return detached Tweaker markers in authoring order. These markers are stored separately from Godot native markers.

method.name: get_marker
method.description: Return the named Tweaker marker or an empty dictionary when it is absent.

method.name: get_marker_time
method.description: Return the named Tweaker marker time in seconds or [param fallback] when it is absent.

method.name: get_notify_track_names
method.description: Return the notify lane names in their authored order.

method.name: get_notifies
method.description: Return independent one-shot notify records. A nonempty name filters records by exact match.

method.name: get_notify_states
method.description: Return independent notify state records. A nonempty name filters records by exact match.

method.name: get_active_notify_states
method.description: Return states active at [param seconds]. A state includes its start and excludes its end. A nonempty [param kind] filters states by exact kind.

method.name: get_events_crossed
method.description: Read events crossed over a forward span in seconds. The end is included. The start is included when [param include_start] is true. Times outside the clip are clipped, and backwards or nonfinite spans produce an empty array.

method.name: get_loop_events_crossed
method.description: Read events from the tail then the head of one loop wrap. Times and loop bounds are in seconds. The starting point on the tail is excluded, and the loop boundaries and head end are included. A [param loop_end] of -1 uses the clip duration. Invalid bounds return an empty array.

constants.constant: A named Tweaker marker is crossed.
